items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: somebody named Sandy Williams seems to have played for a couple of months

ctx.x: And then that stayed constant with the exception of a brief time -- somebody named Sandy Williams seems to have played for a couple of months. You were -- were you not in the band at the end of '42, the beginning of '43? That's what it says here.
Well, I would take vacations quite often, so I didn't -- I don't know who came in. And I really don't remember the exact times that I was out, but I would be out a month or so most every year.
